analysis_notes.summary: Torah #114 is a narrative account by Reb Noson describing a conversation with Rebbe Nachman in which the Rebbe expressed the severity of the damage caused by improper thoughts (hirhurim). The text is a first-person testimony, not a conceptual teaching with bechina structure. The key concept — פְּגַם הַהִרְהוּר (the damage of improper thought) — is presented as a revelation about cause-and-effect (bad thoughts cause severe spiritual damage), not as a parallel-aspect equivalence. No bechina language appears. No packages can be formed.
